description: Monorepo containing FastAPI backend and React frontend with Docker Compose

files.docker-compose.yml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  api:
    build: ./services/api
    ports: ['8000:8000']
  web:
    build: ./services/web
    ports: ['3000:3000']
files.services/api/main.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI
app = FastAPI()
files.README.md:
# Platform Monorepo
Multi-service architecture with FastAPI backend under services/api and React frontend under services/web.

important_facts: Backend service located at services/api using FastAPI
Frontend service located at services/web using React
